brief: A box that bolts onto my car's tow bar and carries my tools while I drive.

requirements.evidence: 3 full bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full) each with drop-in tray: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments), bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full (open), bin:2,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments); 2 bolt covers + 14 end caps + lockJoints
Catalog search for tow/hitch/mount found no tow-bar coupler; only generic L-bracket/anchor/keyhole accessories, none rated as a vehicle mount. No tow-bar interface was modelled.

Middle cell left open to show screwdriver prop:1; closed lids would be needed in transit and other tools (pliers, tape, hexkey-set, multimeter) were refused with PROP_NO_REST as overlapping walls/covers. lockJoints + connectors join cells but configurator checks fit only and knows nothing about vibration, loads, or road safety; parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material with no rating.
No sealing, load, heat/UV/waterproofing or crash-safety verification exists in the configurator; 3D-printed material properties are unknown.
requirements.requirement: Road-worthy strength, weather and safety for exterior car use

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell lidded tool box with divided bins and bolted joints as a shape study, with one screwdriver staged in the open middle cell. There is no tow-bar mount in the Hex Cluster catalog and nothing here is rated for bolting to a car or carrying tools while driving, so the tow-bar and in-transit requirements are unmet — do not mount this on a vehicle.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
